units.source_text: 可是，這種迷信（即使到今天，我依然覺得它是某種迷信）卻總是帶給我不安與恐懼。

en.t: But this superstition, even today I still feel it is a kind of superstition, always brought me unease and fear.

units.source_text: 因為人不吃飯就會死，所以才不得不工作，不得不吃飯。

en.t: Because people will die if they do not eat, they have no choice but to work and no choice but to eat.

units.source_text: 對我而言，再沒有比這句話更抽象難懂、更帶有威脅性的了。

en.t: To me, nothing was more abstract, harder to understand, or more threatening than those words.

units.source_text: 總之，我對人類的行為仍迷惑不解。

en.t: In short, I still could not make sense of human behavior.

units.source_text: 自己的幸福觀與世上所有人的幸福觀迥然不同，

en.t: My own idea of happiness was utterly different from everyone else's idea of happiness,

units.source_text: 這種不安讓我夜夜輾轉難眠，低聲呻吟，幾近發狂。

en.t: and this unease made me toss and turn night after night, groaning softly and nearly going mad.
Was I really happy after all?

units.source_text: 實際上，我小時候常常被人說成是有福之人，

en.t: In fact, when I was little, people often said I was fortunate,

units.source_text: 但我總覺得自己深陷地獄，

en.t: but I always felt as though I had sunk deep into hell,

units.source_text: 反而是那些說我有福的人，遠比我活得快樂。

en.t: and instead it seemed to me that the people who called me fortunate lived far more happily than I did.
